name: kalman_filter_trend_v1
mechanism: NIFTY's intraday trends are driven by institutional TWAP/VWAP algorithms executing directional mandates over 5-20 minute windows, creating persistent but noise-embedded price drift visible in 5-second bars. A Kalman filter with 2 states (price level + velocity) optimally separates genuine trend velocity from observation noise by dynamically adjusting its gain: when the index is in persistent directional flow, the velocity state converges to a stable non-zero value with low estimation uncertainty, yielding a high velocity/uncertainty ratio. When NIFTY's Kalman velocity/sigma exceeds 1.5 in one direction AND price sits above/below the Kalman level estimate AND agrees with session VWAP direction — institutional order flow is active and unexhausted. On NIFTY, these confirmed velocity regimes persist for 30-90 additional seconds, delivering 5-15 option premium points before the institutional batch exhausts and velocity reverts toward zero.
core_signal_oneliner: Kalman velocity/uncertainty ratio above 1.5 sustained 30 seconds with VWAP directional agreement
